## Request Context
- **What was requested**: code review of Phase 3 Unit 3 (retry-chain nesting) build before commit per autonomous_workflow rule
- **Files/scope**: src/telemetry/failures.py (RetryChain dataclass, group_retry_chains, MAX_RETRY_CHAIN_GAP_SECONDS, _retry_pair_chains, _build_retry_chain); src/telemetry/dashboard.py (_render_failure_row extracted, _render_retry_chain added, _render_failure_class_group refactored to compose chains); tests/test_telemetry.py (22 new chain tests); memory/bugs/regression-ledger.md (Unit 3 entry)
- **Developer-stated motivation**: cascade of N retries sharing one root cause should read as one chain not N rows; final Phase 3 unit
- **Explicit constraints**: TEMPORAL heuristic (developer-resolved fork); ADR-0013 read-time only; ADR-0020 honest-absence; SKIP-OVER semantic for non-retry signals (not chain-reset); tz-mismatch caught as no-chain; boundary inclusive; length-1 chain renders byte-equivalent to today's row (structural-absence assertions); WCAG 1.4.1 non-color cue on link rows; declined _group_by_key Rule-of-Three extraction (3 callers' shapes too divergent); /review qa+arch+ux ≥3; NO push

APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES (0.87). 0 BLOCKING / 4 LOW advisories. F1: no render test for a class group containing a length-≥2 chain AND a standalone length-1 retry from the same class (the chain_iter/next_chain double-advancement logic is exercised only for chains-only input). F2: no test for overlapping timestamps (next.first_seen < prev.last_seen → negative gap; <= 120 still holds, but the implicit assumption is untested). F3: escape test only exercises length-1 path; length-≥2 chain link-row interpolation seam (sl.detail, sl.signature) not exercised. F4: no all-priced-both-links arithmetic test (zero-cost test indirectly covers it). Strengths: all A1-A12 + sub-cases have named tests; 7 regression-marked guards target the highest-risk invariants; _chain_rf/_chain_signal helpers deterministic; end-to-end orphan+chain composition test validated.

APPROVE (0.91). 1 LOW + 2 INFO advisories. F1 LOW: chain composition uses signature-equality set for skip lookup where identity (id(rf.signal)) would be more defensive against future signature-namespace collisions (today retry-loop signatures = tool:hash, orphan signatures = tool_use_id/agent_id; no collision possible, but the coupling is content-keyed). RetryChain.all_links() already exists to support this. F2 INFO: link-row markup duplicates _render_failure_row modulo CSS class + leading glyph — already deferred-as-advisory in ledger, do NOT extract until 3rd row variant. F3 INFO: MAX_RETRY_CHAIN_GAP_SECONDS placement in failures.py is correct (pure-logic constant, overridable via kwarg). Boundary integrity preserved (failures.py IO-free, dashboard.py → failures.py one-way); ADR-0013 + ADR-0020 honored throughout; Rule-of-Three decline documented in 3 places (spec C9 + ledger + docstring). Downstream consumers (analyze_failures.py + scripts/telemetry/dashboard.py) untouched. Public-vs-private split (group_retry_chains public; _render_* private) principled and documented.

APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES (0.88). 1 MED + 2 LOW/INFO, 0 BLOCKING. F1 MED ADVISORY: aria-label on <tr> may not be reliably announced by NVDA/JAWS in table context — the table navigation model reads cell content, not row labels. A user relying on a screen reader may hear the cell content but not 'Retry chain (N consecutive retries)'. Remediation A (cheap): visually-hidden <span class='sr-only'> as first child of parent first cell. Remediation B (richer): wrap parent + links in <tbody role='rowgroup' aria-label=...>. F2 LOW: no CSS rules for .retry-chain-parent / .retry-chain-link / .chain-glyph in the inline stylesheet — parent row has no visual treatment differentiating it from a normal flat row; link rows rely entirely on the glyph character. Add minimal rules. F3 INFO: failure_type column shows raw 'retry_loop' — engineer jargon visible to manager; already deferred from Unit 1 (ux F4 residual), out of scope here. Strengths: chain badge plain language; honest-absence carried through to chain total ('uncosted' not '/usr/bin/bash'); aria-hidden on glyph correctly splits visual/SR; length-1 short-circuit = zero regression risk for non-cascade rows; test pins for aria-hidden + structural-absence already in regression suite.

## Request Context
- **What was requested**: code review of Phase 3 Unit 3 (retry-chain nesting) before commit
- **Files/scope**: src/telemetry/failures.py + src/telemetry/dashboard.py + tests/test_telemetry.py + memory/bugs/regression-ledger.md
- **Developer-stated motivation**: cascade of N retries with one root cause = one chain not N rows; final Phase 3 unit
- **Explicit constraints**: TEMPORAL fork resolution; ADR-0013 read-time only; ADR-0020 honesty; declined _group_by_key Rule-of-Three; ≥3 specialists; NO push

## Synthesis
3 specialists APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES → APPROVE post-fold. 0 BLOCKING; 1 MED + 6 LOW + 3 INFO advisories. 6 folded in-session, 2 deferred-as-advisory (qa F4 all-priced test polish; ux F3 display-label pre-existing-residual). Quality gate 7/7 (374 tests, 44 regression-marked guards).

**Folds**:
- ux F1 MED: aria-label on <tr> unreliable in NVDA/JAWS table-nav → added <span class='sr-only'> in parent first cell as authoritative SR cue; aria-label retained as belt-and-braces; .sr-only CSS added to inline stylesheet
- arch F1 LOW: skip-set switched from signature-equality to identity (id(rf.signal)) via RetryChain.all_links() — defensive against future signature-namespace evolution
- qa F1 LOW: test_failures_panel_class_group_with_chain_and_standalone_retry_composes (exercises chain_iter/next_chain double-advancement)
- qa F2 LOW: test_group_retry_chains_overlapping_signals_chain (pins negative-gap admission)
- qa F3 LOW: test_chain_link_row_fields_are_escaped (exercises link-row interpolation seam)
- ux F2 LOW: minimal CSS rules for .retry-chain-parent (font-weight) + .retry-chain-link (left padding) + .chain-glyph (muted color)

**Side-effect**: existing test_length_one_chain_renders_no_chain_scaffold tightened from substring assertion to class-attribute-specific match (CSS rule contains bare selector substring).

**Confidence weighted**: qa 0.87 + arch 0.91 + ux 0.88 = ~0.89.
**Counts (transparency)**: 0 speculative findings (none below 0.80 threshold); 0 unscored.
**Model tiers**: qa-specialist:opus + architecture-consultant:opus + ux-evaluator:opus.
**Report**: docs/reviews/REV-20260610-003237.md.

**Verdict**: approve-with-changes → APPROVE post-fold. Ready for commit (NO push).
